attempts.text:
**The window opens on a two-column spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `gcvH` to `gcvP`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99.6 to 100% of them, fewest at column 1, `gcvP`, 99.6%.

Through columns 45 to 48 a branch of 4 shell families runs in 18 to 21%, [[type III secretion]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.34 against 0.47 bits. It hesitates most at column 41, `yqeF`, a fork column, 2.00 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 44 to 79, `araE` to `ygdI`, are carried by 11 to 89%, in a region of plasticity in 16 to 67% of calls. The last column is `ygdI`, in 23% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 91% of genes**, 0.43 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.69 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 95%.

label: gcvH
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the gcvH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gcvH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 831 to 910 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gcvH once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.43 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 22,843 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; shell 19,743 calls, named 87%, 0.66 bits; cloud 614 calls, named 16%, 3.90 bits. Outside an RGP 20,919 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 22,281 calls, named 88%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 21 spine, 24 fork, 35 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 95%); 22,281 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 41 (yqeF, a fork column) 2.00 bits, RGP 74%; column 42 (kduI, a spine column) 1.64 bits, RGP 72%; column 43 (kduD, a spine column) 1.25 bits, RGP 69%. The 44 columns (columns 14-57) where most calls are in an RGP: named 90%, 0.58 bits on average; the other 36 columns: named 93%, 0.26 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 21 spine columns: named 94%, 0.34 bits on average; the 59 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.47 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 41, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 16 (variable), RGP 97%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: gcvH, gcvP "aminomethyl-transferring glycine de…". named 99.6-100% (mean 99.8%), fewest named at column 1 (gcvP), named 99.6%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.06 bits (column 1 (gcvP)).
[S2] 2. column 2 variable: share 53%, all S, RGP 0.2%. named 41%; 0.79 bits.
[S2.c2]    2: ygfF S 53% "SDR family oxidoreductase"
[S3] 3. columns 3-15 (13 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 0.2-97%. Genes: bglA, yqfB "N(4)-acetylcytidine aminohydrolase", trhA, ygfZ "tRNA-modifying protein YgfZ", sdhE, ygfX "protein YgfX", fldB, xerD, dsbC, recJ, prfB, lysS, idi. named 91-99.6% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 15 (idi), named 91%, 0.42 bits.
[S4] 4. column 16 variable: share 84%, all S, RGP 97%. named 95%; 0.45 bits.
[S4.c16]    16: "protein YqfH" S 84%
